kind: Read-only Google Cloud Console release audit; a dated configuration observation, not a provider test or change to the Cloud project.

observed.audience: External, Publishing status Testing; 2 test users; the Publish app control is disabled and the console directs completion of Branding.
observed.branding: Application name and support/developer emails are present. The homepage, public privacy-policy link, terms link and authorized-domain list are empty in the visible configuration. The console's Branding completion gate is not satisfied.
observed.data_access: The restricted Drive-scope list contains drive.readonly only. Cirrove's current crates/cirrove-auth/src/google.rs requests drive.readonly for read-only connections and the full drive scope for writable connections; the latter is not declared on this screen.
observed.verification: The Verification Center says verification is not currently required because the app is in Testing. It does not show production restricted-scope approval.
observed.api_services: The Google Drive API is enabled. The Google Docs API and Google Sheets API showed Enable controls; a direct Docs API read returned SERVICE_DISABLED. No API was enabled during this audit.

policy_implication: Google says production apps should declare every requested scope and restricted Drive scopes require verification unless an exception applies. Its verification requirements call for a public homepage and privacy policy on a verified domain. This project remains suitable for the two listed testers, not general Google-account onboarding.
next_actions: Choose a public, verified domain and publish a truthful Cirrove homepage and privacy policy before filling the Branding fields; the repository currently lists GitHub as its homepage and contains no public privacy policy.
Declare the full drive scope actually requested for writable connections, then prepare restricted-scope and brand verification evidence before publishing beyond testers.
Keep the Docs API activation and the registered native-revision probe separate; no Cloud project setting changes were made by this audit.
